review_scope: Main paper and complete five-page supplementary information
finding: Table 2 reports bulk copolyester TGA and Table 3 reports bulk copolyester LOI. Table 7 separately measures fibers, giving 21.0±0.3, 31.9±0.2 and 34.1±0.1 for Pure PET, PETP and PETP-3Si, with no separately measured fiber TGA. No same-form textile pair is admitted. The supplement covers DDP/DDP-EG TGA and copolyester DSC, not fiber TGA.
legacy_mismatch: PETP-0.6Si does not occur in Table 1. All five legacy numeric sets differ from the cited source. Preserve originals as unverified and do not promote. Actual Table 2 T5 values: 370.3, 386.5, 380.0, 380.9, 381.2°C. Table 3 LOI values: 21.2, 32.5, 32.8, 33.8, 34.8%.

reason: Control LOI ca.18.4 is approximate; other washing states lack same-state TGA. Four 50-cycle states are retained.
Original Table 5 PDF and XML share defective headings. Later peak/residue columns are not mapped. Only three explicitly stated prose residues retained: Ni air4.5, Ni N2 8.6, Fe air6.3.
PAP-100, PAPBTCA-100 and separately washed5Ls states have LOI but no same-state TG data. Complete three-page SI reviewed and adds no pairs.
